data.rationale: The proposed procedure matches the true one in goal and step order (search, open venue, set guests/date, Notify, set time range, confirm), but its parameters are off: it has query, city and meal where the true workflow has restaurant and time, and the time-window input is never named as a parameter, so an automation built from it would have to guess some inputs.
